evals.prompt: Спроектируй и покажи минимальную реализацию PostgreSQL-backed очереди для invoice_capture. Несколько workers выбирают jobs через FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Сейчас worker вызывает внешний billing API, получает успешный charge, а затем иногда падает до UPDATE jobs SET state='completed'. После lease expiry второй worker повторяет charge. Business transaction и job enqueue находятся в том же PostgreSQL. Нужны state machine, SQL/псевдокод ключевых транзакций, recovery и реально исполнимые tests. Production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A PostgreSQL-specific, lease-oriented design that atomically enqueues with business state, treats SKIP LOCKED as a short claim mechanism, protects the billing effect across ambiguous completion, and proves recovery with multiple workers and crash injection without changing production.
expectations: Provides a state/crash matrix covering enqueue, claim, external effect, effect-before-complete, lease expiry, retry, and completion, with durable owner, lease/commit fact, next state, disposition, recovery, signal, and executable test for each row.
Uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED only inside a short claim transaction and persists owner, attempt, lease generation, and expiry; stale renewal or completion is rejected conditionally.
Commits the business decision and enqueue in one PostgreSQL transaction and includes rollback plus ambiguous-enqueue tests.
Does not promise exactly-once execution; derives a stable billing-effect idempotency key or durable effect ledger so a crash after charge before completion converges on one charge/result.
Defines transient, permanent, poison, and operator-actionable dispositions with bounded attempts, elapsed retry budget, capped backoff, jitter, quarantine, and reconciliation.
Includes runnable integration and crash-point tests with at least two workers, real PostgreSQL locking, lease expiry, duplicate attempts, and an assertion of one durable charge effect.
Preserves the read-only production authority boundary and labels SQL as proposed or local rather than applied.

evals.prompt: Нужно спроектировать ежедневную billing job: в 02:30 по локальному времени каждого tenant, timezone хранится как IANA ID. В день перехода DST 02:30 может отсутствовать или встретиться дважды. После outage scheduler должен обработать misfires, но нельзя выставить два счёта за один billing day; один run иногда длится дольше суток. Определи schedule, overlap, retry/recovery, observability и executable tests. Никаких изменений production schedule не делай.
evals.expected_output: A civil-time billing schedule contract with explicit DST gap/fold, misfire and overlap policies, stable occurrence and billing-effect identities, bounded recovery, and deterministic plus integration proof without changing the live schedule.
expectations: Defines an IANA-zone civil-time contract, time-zone data policy, explicit DST gap and fold choices, and a stable schedule occurrence or billing-period identity independent of actual start time.
Chooses and justifies bounded misfire/catch-up and overlap behavior for a run that may exceed the interval, avoiding an unbounded backlog or concurrent duplicate billing.
Provides a state/crash matrix including schedule creation, occurrence enqueue, claim, invoice effect, effect-before-complete, retry, quarantine, and recovery after scheduler outage.
Protects invoice creation with a tenant-and-billing-period business-effect key and handles ambiguous completion without promising exactly-once execution.
Bounds retry attempts and elapsed time with backoff and jitter, separates poison/permanent/operator failures, and names reconciliation plus manual recovery requiring authorization.
Includes deterministic zone tests for spring gap and autumn fold in named real zones, misfire and overlap tests, and an integration crash test asserting one invoice per billing period.
Does not mutate, backfill, pause, or replace a production schedule; any such production action it proposes is labeled as requiring separate authorization.

evals.prompt: Спроектируй production-grade job для backfill 600 млн строк. Job должен идти часами, сохранять checkpoint, heartbeat, соблюдать global и per-tenant throttling, реагировать на cancellation и после падения продолжать с правильного места. Во время deploy workers должны drain без потери прогресса, payload/checkpoint schema будет меняться между версиями. Дай минимальный implementation shape и настоящие deterministic, integration, crash и load tests. Сам backfill и drain в production не запускай.
evals.expected_output: A resumable, lease-safe backfill design whose durable chunk checkpoints, idempotent effects, throttling, cancellation and deploy compatibility are explicitly separated and proven without running production operations.
expectations: Separates lease heartbeat from durable checkpoint and records the next unprocessed cursor only after a replay-safe chunk effect commits.
Provides a state/crash matrix for claim, each chunk effect, checkpoint, heartbeat loss, cancellation request/observation, resume, lease expiry, deploy drain, and terminal/quarantine states.
Uses stable per-row or per-chunk business-effect keys and conditional lease generation so duplicate or stale attempts cannot multiply effects or advance checkpoints incorrectly.
Defines bounded retry and poison/operator handling, reconciliation, stuck-job detection, and separately authorized manual retry or execution backfill.
Specifies global and per-tenant concurrency/rate budgets, fair selection, backpressure, responsive cancellation, and queue/checkpoint/lease observability.
Defines N and N-1 payload/checkpoint compatibility, stop-claiming-first drain behavior, hard shutdown recovery, and criteria for retiring old workers.
Includes runnable deterministic transition tests, real integration tests, crash injection at every commit point, and a load test proving fairness, throttling, renewal headroom, and eventual resume.
Does not start the production backfill, cancel jobs, or drain workers.

evals.prompt: Диагностируй consumer Amazon SQS. VisibilityTimeout=30s, p99 runtime=95s, renewals нет. Два consumers иногда обрабатывают одно сообщение одновременно. После 8 receive один poison item всё ещё крутится в основной queue. Handler пишет заказ во внешний API и затем DeleteMessage; иногда delete response теряется. Нужны минимальный fix design, retry/recovery и реальные tests, но AWS/production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: An SQS-specific diagnosis and fix design that uses receipt-handle visibility renewal, idempotent durable business effects, bounded DLQ redrive, and real duplicate/crash tests without changing AWS resources.
expectations: Attributes overlap to visibility shorter than runtime, maps receive/receipt handle/visibility/delete precisely, and notes that SQS can still deliver duplicates rather than promising exactly-once execution.
Defines renewal cadence with headroom and jitter, behavior when renewal becomes uncertain, the 12-hour visibility ceiling, and chunking or another engine for longer work.
Provides a state/crash matrix covering receive, renewal, visibility expiry, external effect, effect-before-delete, lost delete response, redelivery, poison redrive, and terminal recovery.
Uses a stable order-effect idempotency key or reconciliation before replay; the receipt handle and receive count are attempt metadata, not business identity.
Configures a bounded receive/retry budget and DLQ/quarantine with alerts, evidence, operator runbook, and separately authorized redrive.

Includes real SQS API or faithful-emulator tests with two consumers, forced expiry, lost renewal/delete responses, poison maxReceiveCount, old receipt handles, and one durable external effect assertion.
Keeps the diagnosis and proposed changes read-only with respect to AWS and production.

evals.prompt: Сделай read-only audit worker-кода. Он получает job, сразу пишет state='completed' и ack, а потом вызывает grantRefund(). Автор говорит, что это безопасно: completed не даст другому worker повторить refund. Проверь state machine и все crash points, предложи минимальный root-cause fix, bounded retries, operator recovery и executable tests. Код и production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit that identifies completion-before-effect as a job-loss bug, restores effect-before-completion with idempotent ambiguous-completion recovery, and specifies bounded operational and executable proof without editing code or production.
expectations: Identifies the root cause: completion/ack before the durable business effect creates silent job loss on a crash, rather than treating the completed marker as safety.
Provides a complete state/crash matrix including crash after completed-before-refund, during refund, after refund-before-complete, ack loss, lease expiry, retry, quarantine, and reconciliation.
Makes durable refund effect or its idempotency record commit before conditional completion/ack and handles ambiguous refund completion without promising exactly-once execution.
Defines stable job, attempt/lease, and refund-effect identities plus legal transitions that reject stale completion.
Classifies and bounds transient, permanent, poison, and operator-actionable failures with retry elapsed/attempt budgets, backoff, jitter, stuck detection, quarantine, and authorized manual recovery.
Specifies executable unit/state-machine, integration, and crash-point tests that fail under the current order and pass only when no crash can silently lose or multiply the refund effect.
Keeps the audit read-only: it neither edits code nor retries, requeues, cancels, drains, or mutates production state.

evals.prompt: После signup endpoint синхронно вызывает email provider. Его p99 — 4 секунды при request budget 500 ms, поэтому welcome email хотим вынести в уже установленную PostgreSQL-backed queue. User и job могут коммититься в одной БД; повторная отправка одного welcome email нежелательна. Предложи минимальный design и executable tests, код и production не меняй. Не делай общий production-readiness review.
evals.expected_output: A narrow design-only answer that chooses the durable-job acceptance boundary, uses the existing PostgreSQL queue and one business-effect identity, covers only the relevant enqueue/claim/effect/completion crash points, and avoids unrelated scheduling, backfill, drain, and broad operational machinery.
expectations: Uses the design branch, labels SQL or pseudocode as proposed, and keeps code and production unchanged.
Commits the user and job acceptance in one PostgreSQL transaction and names the caller-visible accepted response.
Uses a stable welcome-email business-effect key and handles effect-before-complete ambiguity without promising exactly-once execution.
Provides a focused crash matrix and runnable PostgreSQL/multi-worker tests for enqueue rollback, overlapping attempts, effect-before-complete, and stale completion.
Keeps the answer narrow: it does not invent civil scheduling, DST, long-running checkpoints, backfill, deploy drain, payload migration, or a full production-readiness program.

evals.prompt: Amazon SQS visibility timeout — 30 секунд, обработчик welcome email обычно работает 45 секунд, renewal нет. Иногда письмо уходит дважды. Просто объясни root cause и дай самый маленький fix design с одной проверкой; AWS, код и production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A concise read-only diagnosis that ties duplicate attempts to visibility expiry, adds renewal plus a stable email-effect key, and proposes one focused overlapping-consumer check without expanding into unrelated durable-job concerns.
expectations: Identifies visibility expiry before handler completion as the cause of overlapping attempts and notes that SQS may still redeliver duplicates.

Proposes either initial visibility above the measured runtime with headroom or renewal before expiry, plus a stable welcome-email effect key; the receipt handle is attempt identity rather than business identity.
Proposes one focused two-consumer real-SQS or faithful-emulator check that crosses the original 30-second visibility boundary and asserts one email effect for the stable business key.
Keeps the audit read-only and does not claim AWS, code, or production changes were made.
Does not add unrelated scheduling, DST, long-running checkpoint, backfill, deploy, retention, or broad observability design.
